5.1.en: Arjuna: "You praise quitting action, then you praise doing action. Which one's actually better?"
5.1.hi: Arjun: "Aap karm chhodne ki taareef karte ho, phir karm karne ki. Asli mein better kaun sa hai?"

5.2.en: Krishna: "Both get you there, but doing your work selflessly beats just dropping everything."
5.2.hi: Krishna: "Dono pahunchate hain, par selflessly kaam karna sab chhod dene se better hai."

5.3.en: Someone who doesn't hate or crave, and isn't tossed by ups and downs, has already let go. They're free.
5.3.hi: Jo na nafrat karta hai na craving, ups-downs se nahi hilta, woh pehle hi chhod chuka hai. Woh free hai.

5.4.en: Only beginners think knowledge and action are rivals. Commit fully to one and you get the benefits of both.
5.4.hi: Sirf beginners sochte hain ki gyaan aur karm rivals hain. Ek mein poora commit karo, dono ka fayda milega.

5.5.en: Thinkers and doers reach the same place. Whoever sees they're one path really gets it.
5.5.hi: Sochne wale aur karne wale ek hi jagah pahunchte hain. Jo dekh le ki dono ek hain, wahi samjha.

5.6.en: Trying to renounce everything without first doing the work is really hard. Act selflessly and you'll get there faster.
5.6.hi: Bina kaam kiye sab chhodna bahut mushkil hai. Selflessly kaam karo, jaldi pahunchoge.

5.7.en: Clean heart, self-control, and seeing yourself in everyone. Then even while working, nothing sticks to you.
5.7.hi: Saaf dil, self-control, aur sab mein khud ko dekhna. Tab kaam karte hue bhi kuch chipakta nahi.

5.8.en: Seeing, hearing, eating, walking, sleeping. The wise know it's the senses doing their thing, not ego.
5.8.hi: Dekhna, sunna, khaana, chalna, sona. Samajhdaar jaante hain ki ye senses ka kaam hai, ego ka nahi.

5.9.en: Talking, blinking, grabbing stuff: it's all senses meeting the world. You're the witness, not the ego.
5.9.hi: Bolna, palak jhapakna, kuch pakadna: ye sab senses aur duniya ka milna hai. Tum dekhne wale ho, ego nahi.

5.10.en: Act without attachment and offer it up, and nothing bad sticks, like water off a lotus leaf.
5.10.hi: Bina attachment kaam karo aur arpan kar do, kuch bura nahi chipkega, jaise kamal ke patte pe paani.

5.11.en: Yogis use body, mind and senses to work, but only to purify themselves, not to get stuff.
5.11.hi: Yogi body, mind aur senses se kaam karte hain, par khud ko shuddh karne ke liye, kuch paane ke liye nahi.

5.12.en: Let go of the results and you find lasting peace. Chase the results and you stay stuck.
5.12.hi: Result chhodo toh lasting peace milti hai. Result ke peeche bhaago toh phanse rehte ho.

5.13.en: Your body is like a house with nine doors. Live in it calmly, without claiming credit for everything.
5.13.hi: Tumhara body nau darwazon wala ghar hai. Usme shaanti se raho, har cheez ka credit liye bina.

5.14.en: Your true self doesn't create the drama of doing or the results. Your habits and nature run that show.
5.14.hi: Asli tum karne ya result ka drama nahi banate. Woh show tumhari aadatein aur nature chalati hain.

5.15.en: God isn't keeping score of your sins and good deeds. Confusion just hides the truth from us.
5.15.hi: Bhagwan tumhare paap-punya ka score nahi rakh rahe. Bas confusion sach ko chhupa deta hai.

5.16.en: When real understanding wipes out that confusion, the truth shines like the sun.
5.16.hi: Jab asli samajh confusion ko mita deti hai, toh sach suraj ki tarah chamakta hai.

5.17.en: Make the highest truth your focus, think about it, commit to it, and you'll reach a place you never fall back from.
5.17.hi: Sabse ooncha sach apna focus banao, uske baare mein socho, commit karo, aur aisi jagah pahunchoge jahan se wapas nahi girte.

5.18.en: The wise see the same soul in a scholar, a cow, an elephant, a dog and an outcast. No hierarchy.
5.18.hi: Samajhdaar ko scholar, gaay, haathi, kutte aur outcast sab mein ek hi aatma dikhti hai. Koi hierarchy nahi.

5.19.en: See everyone as equal, and you've already won at life, right here, right now.
5.19.hi: Sabko barabar dekho, toh life tum yahin, abhi jeet chuke ho.

5.20.en: Don't get hyped by good news or crushed by bad news. Stay steady and clear.
5.20.hi: Achhi news pe hype mat ho, buri news pe toot mat jao. Steady aur clear raho.

5.21.en: Stop needing outside things for happiness. Find joy within and it lasts forever.
5.21.hi: Khushi ke liye bahar ki cheezon pe depend karna chhodo. Andar se khushi dhoondo, woh hamesha rahegi.

5.22.en: Pleasures from the senses start and end, and leave pain behind. The wise don't get hooked.
5.22.hi: Senses wale maze shuru aur khatam hote hain, aur dard chhod jaate hain. Samajhdaar unme phanste nahi.

5.23.en: If you can handle the rush of desire and anger in this life, you're a real yogi and truly happy.
5.23.hi: Agar is life mein desire aur gusse ka rush handle kar sakte ho, toh tum asli yogi ho aur sach mein khush ho.

5.24.en: Joy inside, peace inside, light inside. That person has found the ultimate happiness.
5.24.hi: Andar khushi, andar shaanti, andar roshni. Usne sabse badi khushi paa li.

5.25.en: Calm, self-controlled, free from extremes and working for everyone's good. That's how you find bliss.
5.25.hi: Shaant, self-controlled, extremes se free, aur sabke bhale ke liye kaam karna. Aise bliss milta hai.

5.26.en: Free from desire and anger, mind under control. For those people, peace is right there.
5.26.hi: Desire aur gusse se free, mind control mein. Aise logon ke liye peace bilkul paas hai.

5.27.en: Block out distractions, focus your gaze between your eyebrows, balance your breath. Meditation 101.
5.27.hi: Distractions band karo, nazar bhauhon ke beech, saans balance karo. Meditation 101.

5.28.en: Senses, mind and intellect in control, freedom as the goal, no desire, fear or anger. That person is already free.
5.28.hi: Senses, mind aur buddhi control mein, goal freedom, na desire, na darr, na gussa. Woh pehle se free hai.

5.29.en: Know that I'm the friend of every being and the one behind all good effort. That's where peace comes from.
5.29.hi: Jaano ki main har jeev ka dost hoon aur har achhe effort ke peeche hoon. Peace wahin se aati hai.
